mainEntity.name: How should buyers choose custom packaging when food-safety or document-review questions are involved?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buyers should first separate direct food-contact packaging from secondary packaging, retail display packaging, gift packaging and shipping packaging. The best custom packaging route depends on product format, contact scenario, target market, material direction, print and finish choices, and the documents that the buyer needs reviewed before quoting.

mainEntity.name: What should buyers send before asking MUGE PACKAGING for a custom packaging quote involving document review?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buyers should send product category, whether the package touches the product directly, target market, packaging dimensions, product weight, material preference, print and finish direction, artwork status, quantity direction, and any document questions for project-specific review. MUGE PACKAGING can route the project to product and material pages, but compliance conclusions require buyer-supplied documents and project review.
